Myth: your reel has to go viral to bring customers.

A viral reel reaches people all over India. But a salon in Anna Nagar only needs people who can walk in this week.

So a few thousand views from your own area can do more than a few lakh from everywhere.

Fact: show the right local people what you do, every week, and tell them how to book.

Want a plan like that for your business? Book a free consultation (link in the reply).

post.linkedin_text:
Thinking of hiring a social media agency in Chennai, but scared you'll pay and get nothing you can check?

That fear makes sense. So here's exactly how we work at Loyara, step by step.

Most business owners I talk to are not worried about the price. They're worried about not knowing what happens after they pay.

So we built our process around that:

1. Free consultation. We learn your business, your audience and your goals, then recommend a package. No payment for this.

2. You approve the calendar. Every month you see the full content calendar before we shoot anything.

3. Content day. We book shoot days in advance and film the reels, posts and designs at your business.

4. Publish and review. We caption, schedule and, on Growth and Elite, run your Meta Ads. Then we go through the results on your strategy calls.

And payment is 50% before the month's work begins, 50% before final delivery. So you're never paying for a full month you haven't seen.

For example, our Growth package is ₹19,999/month: 8 reels, 2 content days, 4 static posts, 2 motion posters, 2 carousels, Meta Ads management and a monthly performance report.

It's for Chennai businesses that want a social media agency they can actually keep track of.

Which step matters most to you before you hire anyone: 1, 2, 3 or 4?

Let's talk.

#DigitalMarketing #SocialMediaMarketing #ChennaiBusiness
